City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 06, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 9th Floor Council Chambers at
11:31 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, City Treasurer
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Ken Campos, City Attorney

  Staff Present:  Eloy Castillo – Public Works
  Debra Carter- City Attorney

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of March 23, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. KOA Corporation - - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  services provided for construction management services in the amount of $4,711.58.
  Motion carried unanimously.

  3. Thomson Reuters. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  purchase of California Rule of the Court subscription in the amount of $152.90. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Closed Session- Confidential
  4. Margarita Ruiz vs City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to recommend
  settlement on claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
  adjourned at 11:45 a.m. Adjournment
